priorityList.notes: Dark Sacrifice, Undead only, once you are under 70% mana and still healthy: it turns your own health into mana over 15 seconds, plus your Spirit, and its 10 minute cooldown makes it once a fight.
Penance on cooldown, on whoever is hurt: three heals one second apart for one cast every 12 seconds, your best heal per mana.

On the tank at the top rank whenever Weakened Soul is off him: it soaks the next hit and costs a warrior no rage, and the Weakened Soul it leaves turns on Renewed Hope, so the heals that follow crit more and leave Divine Aegis shields.
Keep Renew rank 7 or higher on the tank all fight.
Flash Heal at the top rank on a tank who is really low: the fast heal, and the dear one.
Flash Heal on a party member about to die, as long as your mana is not far behind the fight.
Prayer of Healing once three of your four party members are under 85%: it heals the target and the target's whole party. Rank 4 is the top rank a trainer teaches.
Greater Heal at the top rank as the tank's filler at 60: he takes the big hits, so the big heal goes on him.
Heal on the tank until you learn Greater Heal at 40: it is your biggest heal until then.
Greater Heal rank 1 on a party member who is missing a third of their health: it keeps most of your healing bonus for far less mana than the top rank.
Lesser Heal when Greater Heal rank 1 is out of reach: a small top-up for little mana. Skip it from 40 to 59, where it has lost your healing bonus and only breaks your mana regeneration.
Greater Heal at the top rank as the tank's filler at 60: he takes the big hits, so the big heal goes on him.
